queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Bangladesh Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) Naogaon district route, the public Settlement map-search viewer, and the official map-purchase portal. The viewer documentation and live JavaScript expose an anonymous map workflow, but no bounded Naogaon parcel feature response was obtained.

queries.result: First-party Bengali discovery identified the DLRS Naogaon page and the official Settlement map-search service. The service lists division, district, survey, upazila/thana, mouza, sheet and dag/plot steps; no safe anonymous parcel geometry was verified for Naogaon in this attempt.

officialSources.observation: Official Bangladesh DLRS page specifically names Naogaon and links the national land-record/map services. This is local district custodian evidence, not proof of an open vector API.
Official public map viewer presents Division, District, Survey, Upazila/Thana, Mouza, Sheet and Dag/Plot controls. Its HTML loaded successfully and current JavaScript was inspected.
Official DLRS integrated map-purchase portal describes CS, SA, RS, BRS and BDS mouza-map routes; it does not provide a city-bounded parcel feature API in the inspected public material.

requests.outcome: Viewer HTML loaded over TLS. No login was used. The page exposed the current MapSearch.js configuration.

Current JavaScript exposed POST /Map/GetDivisionList, /Khatian/getdistrictlistdivisionwise, /Khatian/GetSurveyListDistrictWise, /Khatian/GetThanaListBySurveyMap and /Khatian/GetSheetJsonBySurvey, with GeoJSON consumed by Leaflet. No unsafe fields were requested.
Returned Bangladesh divisions; Rajshahi was identified as unit code 030000000.
Returned Rajshahi division districts and identified Naogaon as unit code 031400000 with component code 4126.
Returned an empty JSON array in the bounded anonymous request. No survey, upazila, mouza, sheet, dag or parcel geometry request could be safely advanced from this response.
Returned an empty JSON array for the bounded exploratory survey value; this is not evidence of Naogaon-wide absence and no exact-point inference was made.
